entry_state: Annual and quarterly statements constrain one shared history without identifying all transactions. Deferred-revenue balances identify a net movement,not gross deferrals or collections; dated recognition expectations preserve separate populations. Lease liabilities,payment buckets and purchase commitments are different quantities. The simplified order roll-forward leaves delivery unidentified; its payment-versus-payable illustration continues next.
exit_state: Commitment changes leave delivery and payment choices open. Liquidity depends on restriction,valuation,turnover and actual payers. Segment sales do not locate legal entities,costs or assets; corporate allocations remain unidentified. The product/geography margins now define a four-cell table with unknown China iPhone sales z; its feasibility and stress implications continue next.

findings.observation: Cash-versus-credit delivery entries complete the commitment counterexample. Restricted-current assets remain restricted; securities-turnover residuals are defined without inventing valuation journals or treating market sensitivity as cash loss.

The concentration equation defines set membership and demonstrates both endpoint unions with explicit customer allocations. Vendor receivables keep a separate denominator and origin. No loss probabilities follow.

India illustrates the difference between management geography and physical location. The corporate-cost bridge and two allocations expose unreported regional profit. Country assets and sales retain distinct time and population definitions. The product-region display awaits its following explanation.
